scripts.typecheck: bash -lc 'bash v2/fui-as/scripts/check-runtime-dependency.sh && if [ -x v2/fui-as/node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then v2/fui-as/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p v2/fui-as/tsconfig.json --noEmit; elif [ -x node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then node_modules/.bin/tsc -p v2/fui-as/tsconfig.json --noEmit; else echo "Could not locate tsc in node_modules/.bin." >&2; exit 1; fi'
scripts.test: bash -lc 'bash v2/fui-as/scripts/check-runtime-dependency.sh && if [ -x v2/fui-as/node_modules/.bin/asp ]; then v2/fui-as/node_modules/.bin/asp --verbose -c v2/fui-as/as-pect.config.mjs -a v2/fui-as/as-pect.asconfig.json; elif [ -x node_modules/.bin/asp ]; then node_modules/.bin/asp --verbose -c v2/fui-as/as-pect.config.mjs -a v2/fui-as/as-pect.asconfig.json; else echo "Could not locate asp in node_modules/.bin." >&2; exit 1; fi'
